title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 03:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 03:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z) at 03:00 UTC. The 03:00 hour is now complete (60 samples through 03:59; end-of-hour 0.67/1M). 04:00 UTC is a trailing incomplete hour (only 3 samples to 04:02), so it is not used. Last-180 maximum 1.67 first at 02:34 UTC on 21 September (label 2M; last-180 window from 01:03 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.67. Window start 22:04 UTC on 20 September (359 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新可靠整點估計 Kp = 0.00（標籤 0Z；03:00 UTC）。03:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 03:59，時段末 0.67／1M）。04:00 UTC 為未收滿時段（至 04:02 僅 3 筆），故不採用。近 180 筆最大 1.67（最先見於 2026-09-21 02:34 UTC；標籤 2M；近 180 筆窗自 01:03 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.67。窗起點 2026-09-20 22:04 UTC（359 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (03:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 03:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z even though later minutes in that hour rose to 0.67/1M.

title.en: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake occurred 35 km NNE of Ruteng, Indonesia on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日，印尼 Ruteng 北北東約 35 公里發生規模 5.5 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.5, depth about 10 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 6.4 (us7000tiqc, Papua New Guinea).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 5.5，深度約 10 公里。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 6.4（us7000tiqc，巴布亞紐幾內亞）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.

title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日，土耳其 Saimbeyli 東南約 26 公里發生規模 4.9 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mww 4.9, depth about 10 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 6.4 (us7000tiqc, Papua New Guinea).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mww 4.9，深度約 10 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 6.4（us7000tiqc，巴布亞紐幾內亞）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
